metadata.article_title: Business transactions of partner with limited liability partnership.

article.title: Business transactions of partner with limited liability partnership.
article.content: A partner may lend money to and transact other business with the limited liability partnership and has the same rights and obligations with respect to the loan or other transactions as a person who is not a partner.
article.html:
66Business transactions of partner with limited liability partnership.

Section 66 · Chapter XIV · page 25 of the Act

A partner may lend money to and transact other business with the limited liability partnership and has the same rights and obligations with respect to the loan or other transactions as a person who is not a partner.
